diff_hunk:
@@ -71,33 +71,62 @@ include::img/sv48pte_crg.edn[]
 [#sv57pte_crg]
 include::img/sv57pte_crg.edn[]
 
+The CRW field encodes the PTE behavior for capability load and store operations
+to the page. The extended CRW field encodes the Capability Dirty (CD) and the
+Capability Read Generation (CRG) state for the page.
+The logical CD bit indicates that a capability was stored to the
+virtual page since the last time the CD bit was cleared.
+The logical CRG bit indicates the current generation of the virtual
+memory page with regards to the ongoing capability revocation cycle.
+
+The CRW field encodes logical states that determine the behaviour for capability
+load and store operations to the page.
+
+[[pte_crw_encoding]]
+.Summary of CRW configurations in the PTEs
+[%autowidth,float="center",align="center",cols="<,<,<",options="header"]
+|===
+|PTE.CRW  | PTE.U=1 CHERI load/store semantic | PTE.U=0 CHERI load/store semantic
+| `0b000` | No capability state               | No capability state
+| `0b001` | Reserved                          | Reserved
+| `0b010` | Reserved                          | Reserved
+| `0b011` | Reserved                          | Reserved
+| `0b100` | Capability state, CD=1, CRG=0     | Normal operation^2^
body: why ^2^ and not ^1^ and where is the footnote?
